description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CorsConfig' that configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) settings for a web application. It reads allowed origins from application properties and sets up CORS mappings accordingly.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration component that implements WebMvcConfigurer to customize CORS settings based on allowed origins specified via application properties.
